# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified browser distribution downloaded from the pinned official npm package:

- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/LICENSE

SHA-256:

- `leaflet.js`: `db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a`
- `leaflet.css`: `a7837102824184820dfa198d1ebcd109ff6d0ff9a2672a074b9a1b4d147d04c6`

The BSD 2-Clause licence is preserved in `LICENSE.txt`. The application uses its
own aircraft icons and circle markers, so the default Leaflet marker images are
not needed. Background tiles come from OpenStreetMap during normal map viewing,
with visible attribution and browser caching. No bulk or offline tile download
is implemented. The separate range radar remains available without internet.
